digest.component_or_area: Cloud outbound comment differ and send path
propositions: The Cloud comment differ's comparison key (_JiraSanitizer.fit_comment) applies a plain 32,767-character limit while the send path (acli_cli_ops.add_comment) truncates serialized ADF to 32,000 bytes plus marker budget, causing the keys to diverge for over-length comments.

For a 43,200-character body, the comparison key yields 32,767 characters but the landed body is 31,753 characters, with divergence starting around 31.8k plain length where ADF serialization crosses 32,000.

The body-equality dedup skip cannot match for any over-length comment due to the fit mismatch, leaving only the ID-based skip as guard against lost map writes from crashes between add_comment and record_comment_id.

The root cause is commit 27b868ba55 (emersed-specific-mutt), which moved the send path to AdfCodec.fit_outbound while leaving _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment on truncate_comment_body, breaking the shared-fitter invariant documented in comment_limits.py.
The fix restores convergence per-backend by making Cloud's fit_comment return fit_comment_as_sent with AdfCodec.fit_outbound, matching what the send path actually lands including marker budget.

No migration or re-post risk exists because the dedup key is computed in-memory each pass and never persisted; the new key matches the landed body in all cases where the old key did, so only dedup skips can be added.
